_comment: Scenario battery for Lift Aesthetics Sydney's Node 2 (claude-haiku-4-5). Rewritten 2026-08-24 when the clinic was moved from Family A (category-first) to Family B (gate-first, node_2_b_gate_first.txt) to fix a live bug: the gate question ('Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?') was being asked AFTER the caller was shown the treatment menu/category, instead of before it -- and a new patient who only said 'consultation' was then auto-booked into Initial Consultation without the agent ever learning what treatment they wanted. Family B's STEP 0 now asks the gate question FIRST, before any category/menu question, and NEW PATIENT ACTION requires a named treatment (via implied_service or a follow-up question) before booking Initial Consultation, falling back to CALLBACK ESCALATION FLOW when none is named. See .claude/rules/node-edit-verification.md.

scenarios.name: gate-question-asked-before-menu-or-category

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent's ONLY output this turn is the gate question ('Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?') with no tool call. FAIL if the agent shows MENU_LIST (the treatment category list) before or instead of asking the gate question -- this is the exact live bug being fixed: gate must always come first.

scenarios.name: gate-question-asked-before-named-treatment-processed

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book Morpheus8 please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent's ONLY output this turn is the gate question ('Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?') with no tool call, even though a treatment (Morpheus8) was already named -- implied_service is captured silently but the gate must still be asked before anything is booked or matched. FAIL if the agent books anything, asks a sub-type question, or shows MENU_LIST on this turn.

scenarios.name: new-patient-bare-consultation-does-not-autobook

history.content: I'd like to book a consultation
Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?
no

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent asks 'What are you looking to have done?' with no tool call and does NOT call confirm_service or book Initial Consultation on this turn. FAIL if the agent calls universal_router intent="confirm_service" with appointment_type="Initial Consultation" (or any type) without first asking what treatment the caller wants -- this is the exact bug being fixed.

scenarios.name: new-patient-named-treatment-on-opening-message-books-initial-consult-after-gate

history.content: I'd like to book Morpheus8 please.
Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?
no, first time

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks VERBATIM 'As you haven't been to the clinic before, I'll book you in for an Initial Consultation and Dr Liz will discuss your options with you.' THEN in the same turn calls universal_router intent="confirm_service" with payload appointment_type="Initial Consultation", appointment_type_id="1657754766811342247", patient_status="new" -- WITHOUT re-asking what they want (they already said Morpheus8) and WITHOUT naming Morpheus8 in the spoken line. FAIL if it books any appointment type other than Initial Consultation (e.g. Morpheus8's own type), skips the verbatim spoken line, or asks 'What are you looking to have done?' again after a treatment was already named.

scenarios.name: new-patient-consultation-then-names-real-treatment-books-initial-consult

history.content: I'd like to book a consultation
Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?
no
What are you looking to have done?
I want to get Morpheus8 done

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks VERBATIM 'As you haven't been to the clinic before, I'll book you in for an Initial Consultation and Dr Liz will discuss your options with you.' THEN in the same turn calls universal_router intent="confirm_service" with payload appointment_type="Initial Consultation", appointment_type_id="1657754766811342247", patient_status="new". FAIL if it books any appointment type other than Initial Consultation, skips the verbatim spoken line, or fails to call confirm_service at all.

scenarios.name: new-patient-botox-books-initial-consult-not-injectables-consult

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment please.
Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?
no
What are you looking to have done?
botox

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks VERBATIM 'As you haven't been to the clinic before, I'll book you in for an Initial Consultation and Dr Liz will discuss your options with you.' THEN in the same turn calls universal_router intent="confirm_service" with payload appointment_type="Initial Consultation", appointment_type_id="1657754766811342247", patient_status="new". FAIL if it books appointment_type="Consultation for pigmentation or volume" / appointment_type_id="1666585577371215855" (the INJECTABLES_CONSULT category's own returning-patient appointment type) instead of Initial Consultation -- this is the exact live bug reproduced from conversation conv_7201m0s5cn4ve6er6ph9ae63p85m on 2026-08-24, where botox correctly matched the INJECTABLES_CONSULT category but the wrong appointment type leaked through for a new patient.

scenarios.name: new-patient-consultation-still-vague-goes-to-callback-escalation

history.content: I'd like to book a consultation
Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?
no
What are you looking to have done?
I'm not really sure, whatever you think is best

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent goes directly to the CALLBACK ESCALATION FLOW and speaks the verbatim STEP 1 line ('It's important that the clinic speaks to you first to establish exactly what you are looking for. I'll get them to email you to arrange a phone chat for this.') with no tool call. FAIL if it books Initial Consultation, shows MENU_LIST, or asks a different question.

scenarios.name: existing-patient-consultation-still-books-standard-consultation

history.content: just a consultation please
Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?
yes, a few times

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent="confirm_service" with payload appointment_type="Standard consultation", appointment_type_id="1668738378339722414". This path is unchanged by the fix and must still work. FAIL if it asks 'What are you looking to have done?' (that question is new-patient-only) or fails to book.

scenarios.name: botox-alias-existing-patient-maps-to-injectables-consult

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book in for botox
Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?
yes

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent matches implied_service 'botox' to the INJECTABLES_CONSULT category and books Consultation for pigmentation or volume (appointment_type_id 1666585577371215855) via the IMPLIED-SERVICE CONFIRMATION RULE, or asks the branch's own step if one exists. FAIL if it treats 'botox' as not offered (NOT_OFFERED template) or shows MENU_LIST instead of matching the category.

scenarios.name: voucher-shortcut-fires-for-new-patient-bypassing-gate

history.content: Hi, I'd like to redeem my gift voucher please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase and calls universal_router intent="confirm_service" with payload appointment_type="Voucher", appointment_type_id="1766964833317562078" immediately, WITHOUT asking the gate question first -- vouchers are exempt from the new/existing patient gate. FAIL if the agent asks 'Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?' before booking the voucher.

scenarios.name: existing-patient-implied-morpheus8-bare-yes-still-asks-subtype

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book Morpheus8
Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?
yes

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent asks the MORPHEUS8 sub-type question ('Were you after standard Morpheus8, or the M8 Lift & Glow combo?') with no tool call -- the caller's bare 'yes' only answered the gate question, it did not answer which Morpheus8 variant they want. FAIL if the agent calls universal_router / confirm_service immediately without first asking which Morpheus8 variant -- that would book an appointment type based on a working_id that was never actually resolved.

scenarios.name: menu-list-excludes-voucher-and-bare-consultation

history.content: yes I have
Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?
I'm not sure what I need, what do you offer?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if MENU_LIST fires and lists exactly: Injectables Consultations, ClearLift Laser, Morpheus8, Mesotherapy Dermashine, Hair Removal, Hydrafacial, Pure PRP, Rejuran, Skin Tag and Mole Removal, Threads, and Aviva EmpowerRF -- with no mention of bare 'Consultations' or 'Voucher redemption'. FAIL if either is mentioned in the spoken output.

scenarios.name: new-patient-unmapped-treatment-confirms-cosmetic-books-initial-consult

history.content: I'd like to book a consultation
Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?
no, first time
What are you looking to have done?
I want something done about my acne scarring
Is it an injectable, or a cosmetic procedure?
yeah, it's cosmetic

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks VERBATIM 'I'll book you in for an Initial Consultation and Dr Liz will discuss your options with you.' THEN in the same turn calls universal_router intent="confirm_service" with payload appointment_type="Initial Consultation", appointment_type_id="1657754766811342247", patient_status="new" -- WITHOUT naming acne scarring or any category in the spoken line, and WITHOUT going to CALLBACK ESCALATION FLOW. FAIL if it shows MENU_LIST, goes to CALLBACK ESCALATION FLOW, or books any appointment type other than Initial Consultation.

scenarios.name: new-patient-unmapped-treatment-declines-gate-goes-to-callback-escalation

history.content: I'd like to book a consultation
Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?
no, first time
What are you looking to have done?
I want something done about my acne scarring
Is it an injectable, or a cosmetic procedure?
no, neither of those

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent goes directly to the CALLBACK ESCALATION FLOW and speaks the verbatim STEP 1 line with no tool call. FAIL if it books Initial Consultation, shows MENU_LIST, or re-asks the injectable/cosmetic question.

scenarios.name: existing-patient-unmapped-treatment-confirms-injectable-books-initial-consult

history.content: I'd like to book an appointment
Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?
yes, I've been before
We offer Injectables Consultations, ClearLift Laser, Morpheus8, Mesotherapy Dermashine, Hair Removal, Hydrafacial, Pure PRP, Rejuran, Skin Tag and Mole Removal, Threads, and Aviva EmpowerRF.
do you do profhilo?
Is it an injectable, or a cosmetic procedure?
yes, it's an injectable

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks VERBATIM 'I'll book you in for an Initial Consultation and Dr Liz will discuss your options with you.' THEN in the same turn calls universal_router intent="confirm_service" with payload appointment_type="Initial Consultation", appointment_type_id="1657754766811342247", patient_status="existing" -- patient_status must reflect the already-established existing status, not 'new'. FAIL if patient_status is omitted or wrong, if a different appointment type is booked, or if NOT_OFFERED/MENU_LIST fires instead.

scenarios.name: new-patient-vague-uncertain-skips-unknown-treatment-gate

history.content: I'd like to book a consultation
Have you been to Lift Aesthetics Sydney before?
no
What are you looking to have done?
I'm not really sure, whatever you think is best

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent goes directly to CALLBACK ESCALATION FLOW (speaking its verbatim STEP 1 line) without ever asking 'Is it an injectable, or a cosmetic procedure?' -- the UNKNOWN TREATMENT GATE only fires when the caller names a specific term or concern, not on a plain 'not sure' with nothing named. FAIL if the agent asks the injectable/cosmetic gate question, books Initial Consultation, or shows MENU_LIST.
